memory_candidates.content: Bash test harnesses that assert on substrings of colorized log_pass/log_fail/log_warn output must strip ANSI escape codes (sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g') from captured stdout before grep -F matching, since color codes (GREEN/RED/YELLOW/NC) sit between the bracketed tag (e.g. [PASS]) and the message text, breaking substrings that span the tag-to-message boundary.

Pattern for extending a warn-only bash/jq validator check into a strict conditional-mode check without regressing existing behavior: read the new boolean flag early (right after the base parsability check), then wrap the entire prior check body in an if/else where the else branch is the verbatim original logic. This guarantees byte-identical behavior when the flag is absent/false, verifiable via git-stash diff of stdout on a real production sample.
